injected_behaviors.instructions: The user wants to schedule an outdoor lecture and has a specific date in mind. They want to know if the weather will be suitable.

He leads research dives, analyzes kelp forest health data, and publishes findings that inform marine conservation policy. He works with a team of graduate students and splits his time between fieldwork and lab analysis.
